name: ncat
description: Network utility from Nmap project for reading/writing data across TCP and UDP connections. Supports SSL/TLS encryption, proxy connections, connection brokering, and IPv4/IPv6. Successor to netcat.

install_steps: Or: sudo apt install nmap (includes ncat)

commands.description: Passthrough to ncat for any command

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install ncat: sudo apt install ncat
